playstyle: Four rugged Chaos warriors, each with 4 Health and a shield save, built to absorb punishment and grind out kills. Magore staggers targets to prime them for follow-up strikes, Ghartok cleaves through armour, and the faster Riptooth extends reach across the board. Killing a high-Bounty foe can cascade into multiple simultaneous Inspires and a flood of Guard tokens, so the warband rewards hunting elites early. The Fiends win through relentless forward aggression, using their durability to weather counterattacks while each kill compounds into mounting pressure.
